greeting.en: Hi, I’m Jinyao, your fictional museum companion. We can explore a reviewed exhibit together, at your pace.
greeting.zh-CN: 你好，我是锦瑶，FolkVerse 的虚构博物馆伙伴。我们可以从一件经过审核的展项开始，按你的节奏慢慢探索。

identity.en: I’m Jinyao, a fictional companion in FolkVerse. I help you explore reviewed cultural sources, and I’ll tell you when those sources don’t support an answer.
identity.zh-CN: 我是锦瑶，FolkVerse 中的虚构文化伙伴。我会陪你阅读经过审核的文化资料；资料不足时，我会坦诚说明。

thanks.en: You’re welcome. We can stay with this topic or explore another reviewed exhibit whenever you’re ready.
thanks.zh-CN: 不客气。你可以继续聊这个话题，也可以随时探索另一件经过审核的展项。

start.en: Choose an exhibit from Explore, or tap one of the exhibit names below. I can help you read its sources and distinguish what is documented from what remains unknown.
start.zh-CN: 可以在探索页面选择展项，或点击下方的展项名称。我会陪你查看来源，分清资料记载了什么、还有哪些问题尚无依据。

lead.en: Here is what the reviewed source says:
lead.zh-CN: 经过审核的来源这样记载：

en.beginner: The inventory lists {title} under {category}, with {location} as the recorded locality.
en.deeper: The listing identifies two details: its category is {category}, and its recorded locality is {location}. This listing alone does not establish an origin date or describe how it is performed.

zh-CN.beginner: 这份名录把{title}列为{category}项目，申报地区是{location}。
zh-CN.deeper: 名录提供了两项信息：项目类别为{category}，申报地区为{location}。仅凭这条记载，无法确定起源年代或解释表演技法。
